hook_text: 1 350 learners, buses that seat 65. The calculator says 20 remainder 50. How many buses do you book?
clip_script: School trip from Polokwane: 1 350 learners, buses that seat 65. 1 350 divided by 65 is 20 remainder 50. Book 20 buses? Then 50 learners stay home! Round up: 21 buses. But chips at R45 with R500? 11 packets and R5 change. You cannot buy part of a packet, so ignore the remainder. And a prize of R2 400 shared 1 to 3? Add the parts: 4. Each part R600. So R600 and R1 800. The story decides. What about the leftovers?
visual_style: Learners filling buses row by row with 50 left on the pavement until a 21st bus arrives, then coins splitting into four equal stacks.
mood: Playful problem-solving with a small cliffhanger.
pacing: Quick division, a pause on the stranded learners, then two fast contrasting stories.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the better deal on juice packs.
